resources.string: The old ArchiveTune build is signed with a different key, so the new GitHub release fails to install (\"signature conflict\"). Uninstall the old version with the button below, then install the new one.
⚠ Back up first! Uninstalling deletes all app data. In ArchiveTune open Settings → Backup and save the file. Restore your data from it after installing the new version.
All clear — you can install the new version
Old ArchiveTune found. Uninstall it to install the new version.
Open the new version download page
If the install still fails, check other user profiles (System Clone / Second Space / Dual Apps) and uninstall ArchiveTune there too.
